description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency and, where the panel genome is
annotated, the coding effect: missense, synonymous, stop_gained, stop_lost, start_lost, splice_site, with the
amino-acid change). Each haplotype lists its protein-changing alleles. Panels: 'aet_tauschii_1022' = Ae. tauschii diversity panel, 1,022 sequenced accessions (lineages 1-3, incl. the 493 non-redundant set; sample names as in the VCF, e.g. TA1675, AL878, BW_01034), short-read SNPs on the TA1675 lineage 2 reference within 2 kb of its high-confidence genes (Aet.TA1675.r1... IDs; find them from a wheat gene with aetauschii_gene).
gene: an Ae. tauschii TA1675 gene ID (Aet.TA1675.r1.4D005250); find it from a wheat gene with aetauschii_gene
name: panel_haplotypes
